name: travel-poster-system
description: 旅行计划信息图系统 —— 自动生成可浏览 HTML、每日信息图、PNG 长图与 PDF 的旅行计划平台

scripts.//test:integration: --concurrency=1：多个包的集成测试共用同一个数据库，各自在 beforeEach 里 DELETE FROM users。并行跑会互相清掉对方的夹具，症状是「单独跑都过、一起跑就红」。
scripts.test:validation: pnpm --filter @tps/planning exec vitest run plan-rules repair-plan resolve-plan
scripts.test:idempotency: pnpm --filter @tps/shared exec vitest run idempotency && pnpm --filter @tps/db exec vitest run travel-plans-repository --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @tps/queue exec vitest run integration
scripts.test:projection: pnpm --filter @tps/planning exec vitest run retrieval-projection && pnpm --filter @tps/db exec vitest run retrieval --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:scoring: pnpm --filter @tps/assets exec vitest run scoring selection && pnpm --filter @tps/generation-worker exec vitest run local-library
scripts.test:cache-keys: pnpm --filter @tps/assets exec vitest run cache-keys svg-map
scripts.fixture:render:low-shm: docker compose -f deploy/render-fixture.compose.yml --profile low-shm run --rm --build render-low-shm
